1 John 5:2 We know that we love God's children when we love God and follow His rules.
1 John 5:3 God's love means we follow his rules, and his rules aren't hard to follow.
1 John 5:4 Everything born of God defeats the world, and our faith is the victory that defeats the world.
1 John 5:5 Who is it that defeats the world, if not the person who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
1 John 5:6 This is the one who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not only by water but by water and blood. And the Spirit is the one who shows this is true, because the Spirit is truth.
1 John 5:7 There are three in heaven who testify: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit, and these three are one.
1 John 5:8 There are three things on earth that show the truth: the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
1 John 5:9 If we accept human testimony, God's testimony is even greater: because this is what God has said about his Son.
1 John 5:10 Whoever believes in God's Son has the proof within themselves; but whoever does not believe God has called him a liar, because they do not believe the testimony God has given about his Son.
1 John 5:11 This is what has been recorded: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
1 John 5:12 Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
1 John 5:13 I have written these things to you who believe in the name of God’s Son; so that you may know you have eternal life, and continue to believe in the name of God’s Son.
1 John 5:14 We are sure that if we ask for anything that God wants, he listens to us.
1 John 5:15 If we know that God listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we get the things we asked from Him.
1 John 5:16 If anyone sees their brother or sister commit a sin that does not lead to death, they should pray, and God will give them life. This is for those whose sin does not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death; I'm not saying to pray about that.
1 John 5:17 Every wrong action is a sin, but not all sins lead to death.
1 John 5:18 We know that whoever is born of God does not sin; but the one born of God protects himself, and the evil one cannot harm him.
1 John 5:19 We know we belong to God, while the whole world is trapped in evil.
1 John 5:20 We know that the Son of God has come and has given us the ability to know the true God. We are united with the true God through his Son, Jesus Christ. He is the real God and eternal life.
1 John 5:21 Young ones, stay away from false gods. So be it.

2 John 1:1 I, an older leader, write to the chosen woman and her children, whom I love because we know the truth. Not only I love them, but all who know the truth do too.
2 John 1:2 We live by the truth, and it will always be with us.
2 John 1:3 May grace, mercy, and peace be with you from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father's Son, in truth and love.
2 John 1:4 I was very happy to see some of your children living in truth, just as we were commanded by God.
2 John 1:5 Now I ask you, lady, not as if I'm writing a new rule to you, but the one we've had from the start: that we should love each other.
2 John 1:6 Love means following his commands. Keep the command you’ve known from the start: follow it.
2 John 1:7 Many tricksters have come into the world who do not admit that Jesus Christ has come as a human. Such a person is a liar and against Christ.
2 John 1:8 Take care that we don't lose what we have worked for, but that we get the full reward.
2 John 1:9 Anyone who sins and does not follow Christ's teaching does not have God. Whoever follows Christ's teaching has God the Father and the Son.
2 John 1:10 If anyone comes to you and does not teach this message, do not welcome them into your home or wish them well.
2 John 1:11 Anyone who wishes him well shares in his wrong actions.
2 John 1:12 I have a lot to tell you, but I don't want to do it by writing. I hope to visit you soon and talk in person, so we can both be completely joyful.
2 John 1:13 Your chosen sister's children say hello to you. Amen.

3 John 1:1 The older leader to the dear friend Gaius, who I love truly.
3 John 1:2 Dear friend, I hope that you do well and stay healthy, just as your inner self is doing well.
3 John 1:3 I was very happy when the brothers came and told about the truth in you, just as you live by the truth.
3 John 1:4 I am happiest when I hear that my children live in truth.
3 John 1:5 Dear friend, you are doing a good job whatever you do for the brothers and sisters and for strangers.
3 John 1:6 They have told the church about your kindness. If you help them continue their journey in a way that honors God, you will do well.
3 John 1:7 They went out for the sake of his name and accepted nothing from non-believers.
3 John 1:8 We should welcome such people to help us work for the truth.
3 John 1:9 I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who likes to be the most important among them, does not welcome us.
3 John 1:10 Therefore, if I come, I will remind everyone of what he does, like talking bad about us with mean words: he's not only unhappy with this, he also doesn't welcome other believers, stops those who want to, and throws them out of the church.
3 John 1:11 Dear friends, do not follow what is evil but follow what is good. The person who does good is from God, but the person who does evil has not known God.
3 John 1:12 Demetrius has a good reputation with everyone, and with the truth itself. Yes, and we also testify for him, and you know that what we say is true.
3 John 1:13 I have a lot to say, but I won't write it all with ink and pen to you.
3 John 1:14 I hope to see you soon and talk with you in person. I wish you peace. Our friends send their greetings. Say hello to each of our friends by name.

Jude 1:1 Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, writes to those made holy by God the Father, kept safe in Jesus Christ, and chosen.
Jude 1:2 May you receive more and more mercy, peace, and love.
Jude 1:3 Friends, I tried very hard to write to you about the salvation we share. I found it necessary to write, urging you to fight for the faith given to God's holy people once for all.
Jude 1:4 Some men have secretly entered among us, who were already marked long ago for judgement. They are ungodly, misuse God's kindness for immoral behavior, and reject our only God and Lord, Jesus Christ.
Jude 1:5 I will remind you, even though you once knew, that God, after saving the people from Egypt, later destroyed those who did not believe.
Jude 1:6 God has kept the angels who did not stay in their position of authority but left their home in eternal chains in darkness until the day of the great judgment.
Jude 1:7 Just like Sodom and Gomorrah, and the nearby cities, which indulged in sexual immorality and pursued unnatural desires, serve as a warning by undergoing punishment with everlasting fire.
Jude 1:8 These dirty dreamers pollute their bodies, reject authority, and insult respected figures.
Jude 1:9 Even Michael the archangel, when arguing with the devil about Moses's body, didn't dare to accuse him harshly, but instead said, "God correct you."
Jude 1:10 They speak badly about what they don't understand, but they act on instinct like wild animals, and it leads to their ruin.
Jude 1:11 Trouble to them! They have followed Cain's path, chased Balaam's mistake for money, and were destroyed arguing like Korah.
Jude 1:12 These are like stains at your love feasts, eating with you without shame, like clouds without rain blown by the wind, or like trees with dried-up fruit, twice dead and uprooted.
Jude 1:13 Wild sea waves, spraying their own shame; wandering stars, for which eternal darkness is kept.
Jude 1:14 Enoch, who was the seventh generation after Adam, spoke of these things, saying, "Look, God is coming with thousands of his holy ones."
Jude 1:15 To carry out judgment on everyone, and to show all the ungodly people their wrong actions they did in an ungodly way, and for all the harsh words ungodly sinners spoke against God.
Jude 1:16 These are grumblers and complainers, living to satisfy their own desires. They brag loudly and flatter others for their own benefit.
Jude 1:17 Friends, remember the words the apostles of Jesus Christ said before.
Jude 1:18 They told you that there would be scoffers in the last days, following their own sinful desires.
Jude 1:19 These are the ones who cause divisions, follow their natural desires, and do not have the Spirit.
Jude 1:20 But friends, build yourselves up in your most sacred faith and pray with the Spirit.
Jude 1:21 Stay in God's love, waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
Jude 1:22 Be kind to some, making a change.
Jude 1:23 Save others by scaring them from danger, like pulling them from fire; and hate even clothes stained by sinful lives.
Jude 1:24 To him who can prevent you from falling and make you stand without fault before God with great joy,
Jude 1:25 To the only wise God our Savior, be honor and greatness, authority and strength, both now and forever. Amen.

Revelation 1:1 This is the unveiling of Jesus Christ, which God gave to him to show his servants what must soon happen; and he made it known through his angel to his servant John.
Revelation 1:2 He testified about God's word, Jesus Christ's message, and everything he saw.
Revelation 1:3 Happy is the one who reads, and those who listen to the words of this prophecy, and follow what is written in it, because the time is near.
Revelation 1:4 John to the seven churches in Asia: May you have grace and peace from God, who is, who was, and who will come; and from the seven Spirits in front of his throne.
Revelation 1:5 From Jesus Christ, the trustworthy witness, the first to rise from the dead, and the ruler of earth's kings. He loved us and cleaned our sins with his blood.
Revelation 1:6 God has made us rulers and priests to serve God and his Father; may glory and power be his forever and ever. Amen.
Revelation 1:7 Look, he is coming with the clouds; everyone will see him, even those who hurt him; and all the people of the world will cry because of him. Yes, Amen.
Revelation 1:8 I am the First and the Last, the start and the end, says God, who is, was, and will come, the All-Powerful.
Revelation 1:9 I, John, who am also your brother, and share in your suffering, in God's kingdom and in the patience Jesus Christ taught, was on the island called Patmos because of God's message and to tell about Jesus Christ.
Revelation 1:10 I was filled with the Spirit on God’s day and heard a loud voice behind me, like a trumpet.
Revelation 1:11 Saying, "I am the Beginning and the End, the first and the last: and, what you see, write in a book, and send it to the seven churches in Asia; to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."
Revelation 1:12 I turned to see who was speaking to me. When I turned, I saw seven gold lampstands.
Revelation 1:13 In the middle of the seven lampstands was someone like the Son of Man, dressed in a long robe, with a golden belt around his chest.
Revelation 1:14 His head and hair were white like wool, white as snow; and his eyes were like flames of fire.
Revelation 1:15 His feet were like polished bronze glowing as if in a fire, and his voice was like the noise of many waters.
Revelation 1:16 In his right hand he held seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from his mouth. His face shone like the bright sun.
Revelation 1:17 When I saw him, I fell at his feet like I was dead. But he put his right hand on me and said, "Don't be afraid; I am the first and the last."
Revelation 1:18 I am the one who lives, and was dead; look, I live forever, Amen; and I hold the keys to hell and death.
Revelation 1:19 Write what you have seen, what is now, and what will happen later.
Revelation 1:20 The secret of the seven stars you saw in my right hand and the seven gold lampstands is this: the seven stars are the messengers of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands you saw are the seven churches.

Revelation 2:1 Write to the messenger of the Ephesus church: He who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven gold lampstands says this.
Revelation 2:2 I know your actions, your hard work, your patience, and that you cannot tolerate evil people. You have tested those who claim to be apostles but are not, and you have discovered they are liars.
Revelation 2:3 You have carried on, been patient, worked hard for my sake, and not given up.
Revelation 2:4 However, I have something against you, because you have abandoned your first love.
Revelation 2:5 Remember where you have fallen from, and turn back, and do the first works; or else I will come to you soon, and will take away your candlestick from its place, unless you turn back.
Revelation 2:6 But you have this: you hate what the Nicolaitans do, and I also hate it.
Revelation 2:7 Whoever has an ear should listen to what the Spirit tells the churches; I will allow those who prevail to eat from the tree of life in God's paradise.
Revelation 2:8 Write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: The one who is the first and the last, who was dead and is now alive, says these things.
Revelation 2:9 I know your actions, troubles, and poverty (but you are rich), and I understand the insults from those who claim to be Jews but are not, instead they belong to Satan's group.
Revelation 2:10 Don't be afraid of what you will suffer. The devil will put some of you in jail to test you, and you will face troubles for ten days. Stay faithful even if it means death, and I will give you the reward of life.
Revelation 2:11 Anyone with an ear should listen to what the Spirit tells the churches; whoever overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
Revelation 2:12 Write to the angel of the church in Pergamos: These words are from the one who has the sharp two-edged sword.
Revelation 2:13 I know what you have done and where you live, where Satan has power. You remain true to my name and have not turned away from my faith, even when Antipas, my faithful witness, was killed among you where Satan lives.
Revelation 2:14 But I have some complaints about you, because you have people there who follow Balaam's teaching, which showed Balak how to lead the children of Israel to sin by eating food offered to idols and by committing sexual sins.
Revelation 2:15 You also have people who follow the Nicolaitanes' teaching, which I hate.
Revelation 2:16 Change your ways; if not, I will come to you soon, and I will battle against them with the sharp words from my mouth.
Revelation 2:17 Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit tells the churches. Whoever wins, I will let them eat the secret bread, and I will give them a white stone with a new name on it, a name that no one knows except the one who gets it.
Revelation 2:18 Write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: The Son of God, who has eyes like flames of fire and feet like polished brass, says this.
Revelation 2:19 I know what you do, your love, help, belief, patience, and actions; and your recent works are greater than your earlier ones.
Revelation 2:20 Nevertheless, I have some complaints about you because you allow that woman Jezebel, who claims to be a prophet, to teach and tempt my followers to sin sexually and to eat food offered to idols.
Revelation 2:21 I gave her time to stop her immoral behavior, but she did not repent.
Revelation 2:22 Look, I will throw her onto a bed, and those who cheat with her will suffer greatly unless they are sorry for what they have done.
Revelation 2:23 I will cause her children to die, and all the churches will understand that I am the one who examines minds and hearts. I will reward each of you according to your actions.
Revelation 2:24 I tell you and the others in Thyatira, if you don't follow this teaching and haven't explored Satan's deep secrets, as they say, I will not give you any other difficulty.
Revelation 2:25 Keep firmly to what you already have until I arrive.
Revelation 2:26 Whoever overcomes and does my work until the end, I will give them authority over the nations.
Revelation 2:27 He will rule them with an iron rod; like a potter's vessels, they will be shattered, just as I received from my Father.
Revelation 2:28 I will give him the morning star.
Revelation 2:29 Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit tells the churches.

Revelation 3:1 Write to the angel of the church in Sardis: He who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars says, I know your actions; you have a reputation for being alive, but you are dead.
Revelation 3:2 Stay alert and make stronger what is left, even though it is close to death, because your deeds are not yet complete in God's eyes.
Revelation 3:3 Remember how you have received and heard; keep it firmly and turn away from your wrongs. If you do not stay alert, I will come like a thief, and you will not know when I will come to you.
Revelation 3:4 You have a few people in Sardis who have not dirtied their clothes; they will walk with me dressed in white because they are worthy.
Revelation 3:5 Whoever overcomes will be dressed in white clothes; I will not erase their name from the book of life, but I will acknowledge their name before God and his angels.
Revelation 3:6 If you have an ear, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
Revelation 3:7 Write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: The one who is holy and true, who holds David's key, who opens doors no one can close, and closes doors no one can open, says these things.
Revelation 3:8 I know what you do: see, I have placed an open door before you that no one can close. You have a bit of strength, have obeyed my message, and have not rejected my name.
Revelation 3:9 Look, I will make those from Satan's group, who claim to be Jews but are not and are lying, come and bow down before you and understand that I love you.
Revelation 3:10 Because you have followed my teaching about endurance, I will also protect you from the time of testing that is going to happen to everyone on earth.
Revelation 3:11 Look, I am coming soon. Keep what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
Revelation 3:12 Whoever wins, I will make them a strong supporter in the house of my God. They will never leave it. I will write on them the name of my God, the name of my God's city, the new Jerusalem that comes down from heaven from my God, and I will also write on them my new name.
Revelation 3:13 Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit tells the churches.
Revelation 3:14 Write to the angel of the Laodicean church: The Amen, the reliable and truthful witness, the first of God's creation, says these things.
Revelation 3:15 I know what you do; you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either cold or hot.
Revelation 3:16 Because you are neither hot nor cold, but lukewarm, I will spit you out of my mouth.
Revelation 3:17 Because you say, "I am rich, have lots of things, and need nothing," you do not know that you are truly sad, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
Revelation 3:18 I advise you to buy from me gold refined by fire so you can be wealthy; and white clothes to wear, so your nakedness won't be seen; and put salve on your eyes, so you can see.
Revelation 3:19 I correct and discipline everyone I love. So be eager, and change your ways.
Revelation 3:20 Look, I am waiting at the door and knocking. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and have dinner with him, and he with me.
Revelation 3:21 I will let those who win sit with me on my throne, just as I won and sat down with God on his throne.
Revelation 3:22 If you have an ear, listen to what the Spirit tells the churches.

Revelation 4:1 After this, I saw that a door in heaven was open: and the first sound I heard was like a trumpet speaking to me; it said, "Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after this."
Revelation 4:2 Right away I was in the spirit, and I saw a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it.
Revelation 4:3 The person sitting there looked like he was made of jasper and carnelian stones, and there was a rainbow encircling the throne, which appeared like an emerald.
Revelation 4:4 Around the throne were twenty-four chairs, and on the chairs I saw twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white clothes, with gold crowns on their heads.
Revelation 4:5 From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings, and sounds; and seven flaming lamps were burning before the throne, which are the seven spirits of God.
Revelation 4:6 In front of the throne, there was a clear glass sea like crystal. Around and at the center of the throne, there were four creatures covered with eyes in front and back.
Revelation 4:7 The first creature looked like a lion, the second one like a young cow, the third had a face like a person, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
Revelation 4:8 Each of the four creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes inside. They never stop, day or night, saying, "Holy, holy, holy, God Almighty, who was, and is, and is coming."
Revelation 4:9 When those creatures give praise, respect, and thanks to the one on the throne, who lives forever and ever,
Revelation 4:10 The twenty-four elders kneel before the one on the throne and worship the one who lives forever, and they throw their crowns in front of the throne, saying.
Revelation 4:11 You are worthy, God, to get glory, honor, and power because you created everything, and they were made for your pleasure.

Revelation 5:1 I saw in the right hand of the one sitting on the throne a book written inside and on the back, sealed with seven seals.
Revelation 5:2 I saw a powerful angel calling out loudly, "Who is good enough to open the book and break its seals?"
Revelation 5:3 No one in heaven, on earth, or under the earth could open the book or even look inside it.
Revelation 5:4 I cried a lot because no one was worthy to open and read the book, or even to look at it.
Revelation 5:5 One of the elders said to me, "Don't cry: see, the Lion from the Judah tribe, the Root of David, has succeeded in opening the book and breaking its seven seals."
Revelation 5:6 I saw that in the center of the throne and the four creatures, and among the elders, there was a Lamb that looked as if it had been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into the whole world.
Revelation 5:7 He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the one sitting on the throne.
Revelation 5:8 When he took the scroll, the four creatures and the twenty-four elders bowed down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and gold bowls filled with fragrances, which are the prayers of God's people.
Revelation 5:9 They sang a new song, saying, "You are worthy to take the book, and to open its seals: because you were killed, and have bought us for God with your blood, from every family, language, people, and country."
Revelation 5:10 You have made us kings and priests to serve our God, and we will rule over the earth.
Revelation 5:11 I saw and heard many angels around the throne, the creatures, and the elders. There were millions and millions of them.
Revelation 5:12 Shouting loudly, the Lamb who was killed is worthy to get power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.
Revelation 5:13 Every creature in heaven, on earth, under the earth, in the sea, and everything in them, I heard saying, "Blessing, honor, glory, and power be to the one on the throne, and to the Lamb forever and ever."
Revelation 5:14 The four creatures said, "Amen." The twenty-four elders fell down and worshiped the one who lives forever and ever.

Revelation 6:1 I saw the Lamb open a seal, and I heard what sounded like thunder. One of the four creatures said, "Come and see."
Revelation 6:2 I saw a white horse, and its rider had a bow. He was given a crown and rode out to win many battles and gain victory.
Revelation 6:3 When he opened the second seal, I heard the second creature say, "Come and see."
Revelation 6:4 Another red horse came out, and its rider was given the power to remove peace from the earth and make people kill each other. He was also given a large sword.
Revelation 6:5 When he opened the third seal, I heard the third creature say, "Come and see." I looked, and there was a black horse, and the rider held weighing scales.
Revelation 6:6 I heard a voice among the four creatures say, "A measure of wheat for a coin, and three measures of barley for a coin; but do not damage the oil and the wine."
Revelation 6:7 When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth creature say, "Come and see."
Revelation 6:8 I looked and saw a pale horse. The rider's name was Death, and Hell came with him. They were given power over a quarter of the world, to kill with the sword, hunger, death, and wild animals.
Revelation 6:9 When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been killed because of God's message and their witness.
Revelation 6:10 They shouted loudly, "How long, God, holy and true, until you judge and punish those on the earth for our blood?"
Revelation 6:11 White clothes were given to each of them; they were told to rest for a little while longer until the number of their fellow servants and brothers who were going to be killed like them was complete.
Revelation 6:12 I saw when he opened the sixth seal, there was a huge earthquake; the sun turned black like rough cloth, and the moon turned red like blood.
Revelation 6:13 The stars from the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree drops its early figs when a strong wind shakes it.
Revelation 6:14 The sky split like a rolled-up scroll, and all the mountains and islands shifted from their spots.
Revelation 6:15 The world's leaders, important people, wealthy individuals, top officers, powerful individuals, and all slaves and free people hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
Revelation 6:16 They said to the mountains and rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the one on the throne and from the Lamb's anger."
Revelation 6:17 The great day of God's anger has come; who can stand against it?

Revelation 7:1 After these events, I saw four angels at the earth's four farthest places, holding back the four winds so that no wind would blow on the land, the sea, or any tree.
Revelation 7:2 I saw another angel coming up from the east with God's mark. He shouted to the four angels who had power to harm the earth and sea.
Revelation 7:3 Say, do not harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have marked the servants of God on their foreheads.
Revelation 7:4 I heard how many were sealed: 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel's children.
Revelation 7:5 From the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand were sealed. From the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand were sealed. From the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand were sealed.
Revelation 7:6 Twelve thousand from the tribe of Asher were sealed. Twelve thousand from the tribe of Naphtali were sealed. Twelve thousand from the tribe of Manasseh were sealed.
Revelation 7:7 Twelve thousand from the tribe of Simeon were marked, twelve thousand from the tribe of Levi were marked, and twelve thousand from the tribe of Issachar were marked.
Revelation 7:8 From the Zebulun tribe, twelve thousand were sealed. From the Joseph tribe, twelve thousand were sealed. From the Benjamin tribe, twelve thousand were sealed.
Revelation 7:9 After this, I saw a huge crowd that no one could count, from every nation, family, and language, standing in front of the throne and the Lamb. They were dressed in white and held palm branches.
Revelation 7:10 They shouted loudly, "Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb."
Revelation 7:11 All the angels stood around the throne, the elders, and the four creatures, and they fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God.
Revelation 7:12 Saying, "Amen: Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength to our God forever and ever. Amen."
Revelation 7:13 One of the leaders asked me, "Who are these dressed in white clothes, and where did they come from?"
Revelation 7:14 I said to him, "Sir, you know." He told me, "These are the ones who came from hard times, and they have cleaned their clothes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb."
Revelation 7:15 So they are in front of God's throne, serving Him day and night in His temple; and the one sitting on the throne will live with them.
Revelation 7:16 They will not be hungry or thirsty anymore; the sun and heat will not burn them.
Revelation 7:17 The Lamb at the center of the throne will take care of them and lead them to springs of living water, and God will remove all tears from their eyes.

Revelation 8:1 When he opened the seventh seal, there was quiet in heaven for about half an hour.
Revelation 8:2 I saw the seven angels standing before God; they were given seven trumpets.
Revelation 8:3 Another angel came and stood at the altar with a gold censer; he was given a lot of incense to offer along with all the saints' prayers on the gold altar in front of the throne.
Revelation 8:4 The smoke from the incense, going up with the saints' prayers, rose before God from the angel's hand.
Revelation 8:5 The angel took the incense burner, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it onto the earth. Then there were voices, thunder, lightning, and an earthquake.
Revelation 8:6 The seven angels with the seven trumpets got ready to blow them.
Revelation 8:7 The first angel blew his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood fell to the earth. One third of the trees and all the green grass were burned up.
Revelation 8:8 The second angel blew his trumpet, and it looked like a huge mountain on fire was thrown into the sea, making a third of the sea turn into blood.
Revelation 8:9 A third of the living sea creatures died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
Revelation 8:10 The third angel blew his trumpet, and a large star fell from the sky. It was burning like a torch and dropped on a third of the rivers and on the water springs.
Revelation 8:11 The star is named Wormwood; a third of the waters turned to wormwood, and many people died from the bitter waters.
Revelation 8:12 The fourth angel blew his trumpet, and one third of the sun, one third of the moon, and one third of the stars were struck, so that a third of them turned dark. A third of the day lost its light, and the night was the same.
Revelation 8:13 I saw and heard an angel flying across the sky, shouting loudly, "Trouble, trouble, trouble to the people on earth because of the trumpet sounds from the three other angels that are still to come!"

Revelation 9:1 The fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star fall from the sky to the earth. He was given the key to the bottomless pit.
Revelation 9:2 He opened the endless pit; smoke came out like from a big furnace; it made the sun and air dark.
Revelation 9:3 Locusts came out of the smoke onto the earth, and they were given power like earth's scorpions have power.
Revelation 9:4 They were told not to harm the earth's grass, any green plants, or any trees, but only the people who do not have God's seal on their foreheads.
Revelation 9:5 They were allowed not to kill them, but to cause them pain for five months: and their pain was like the sting of a scorpion when it strikes a person.
Revelation 9:6 In those days, people will want to die, but they won't be able to; they will long for death, but it will escape them.
Revelation 9:7 The locusts looked like horses ready for war; they had what seemed like gold crowns on their heads, and their faces were like human faces.
Revelation 9:8 They had hair like women's hair, and their teeth were like lion's teeth.
Revelation 9:9 They wore chest armor like iron, and the noise of their wings was like many horses and chariots rushing into war.
Revelation 9:10 They had tails like scorpions with stings, and they could harm people for five months with their power.
Revelation 9:11 They had a king, the angel of the abyss, named Abaddon in Hebrew and Apollyon in Greek.
Revelation 9:12 One trouble has passed; look, two more troubles will come after this.
Revelation 9:13 The sixth angel blew his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four corners of the gold altar that is in front of God.
Revelation 9:14 Tell the sixth angel with the trumpet to free the four angels tied up at the big river Euphrates.
Revelation 9:15 The four angels were set free, who were ready for an hour, a day, a month, and a year, to kill a third of the people.
Revelation 9:16 The army of horsemen was 200 million; I heard their count.
Revelation 9:17 In the vision, I saw horses and their riders wearing fiery, blue, and sulfur chest protectors. The horses had heads like lions, and fire, smoke, and sulfur came out of their mouths.
Revelation 9:18 Through these three, a third of people were killed—by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur that came from their mouths.
Revelation 9:19 Their strength is in their mouths and tails: their tails are like snakes with heads, and they use these to harm.
Revelation 9:20 The other people who were not killed by these disasters still did not change their minds about what their hands had done. They did not stop worshiping demons and idols made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see, hear, or walk.
Revelation 9:21 They did not turn away from their murders, magic, sexual sins, or thefts.

Revelation 10:1 I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven, dressed in a cloud, with a rainbow on his head, his face shining like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
Revelation 10:2 He held an open small book in his hand, and he put his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
Revelation 10:3 He shouted loudly like a roaring lion, and when he shouted, seven thunders spoke out.
Revelation 10:4 When the seven thunders spoke, I was ready to write, but a voice from heaven told me, "Keep secret what the seven thunders said and do not write it down."
Revelation 10:5 The angel I saw standing on the sea and the earth raised his hand to the sky.
Revelation 10:6 He promised by the one who lives forever and ever, who made the sky and everything in it, the earth and everything on it, and the sea and everything in it, that there would be no more waiting.
Revelation 10:7 But when the seventh angel is about to blow his trumpet, the secret plan of God will be completed, just as he told his prophets.
Revelation 10:8 The voice I heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, "Go and take the small open book from the angel standing on the sea and the earth."
Revelation 10:9 I went to the angel and asked him for the small book. He told me, "Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but it will taste as sweet as honey in your mouth."
Revelation 10:10 I took the small book from the angel's hand and ate it. It tasted sweet like honey in my mouth, but when I ate it, my stomach felt bitter.
Revelation 10:11 He told me, "You must speak God's message again to many people, nations, different language speakers, and rulers."

Revelation 11:1 I was given a stick like a measuring rod, and the angel stood and said, "Get up and measure God's temple, the altar, and the people who worship there."
Revelation 11:2 Leave out the outer court of the temple and do not measure it, because it has been given to non-Jews, and they will walk all over the holy city for 42 months.
Revelation 11:3 I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will speak God's message for 1,260 days, dressed in rough clothing.
Revelation 11:4 These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands in front of the God of the earth.
Revelation 11:5 If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and eats up their enemies. If anyone tries to hurt them, they must be killed the same way.
Revelation 11:6 They have the power to close the sky so it doesn't rain during their prophecy, to turn water into blood, and to strike the earth with all kinds of diseases whenever they want.
Revelation 11:7 When they finish giving their message, the beast from the abyss will fight them, defeat them, and kill them.
Revelation 11:8 Their dead bodies will lie in the street of the great city, which in a spiritual sense is named Sodom and Egypt, where our Lord was also crucified.
Revelation 11:9 People from different families, languages, and countries will see their dead bodies for three and a half days and will not allow their bodies to be buried.
Revelation 11:10 People on earth will be happy about them, celebrate, and give each other presents because these two prophets caused trouble for those living on earth.
Revelation 11:11 Three and a half days later, the breath of life from God came into them, they stood up, and those who saw them were very afraid.
Revelation 11:12 They heard a loud voice from heaven say to them, "Come up here." And they went up to heaven in a cloud while their enemies watched.
Revelation 11:13 At that time, a huge earthquake happened, and one-tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand people died in the earthquake. The survivors were scared and praised the God of heaven.
Revelation 11:14 The second terrible event is over; look, the third terrible event is coming soon.
Revelation 11:15 The seventh angel blew his trumpet; loud voices in heaven said, "The world's kingdoms are now God's kingdoms and his Messiah's, and he will rule forever and ever."
Revelation 11:16 The twenty-four elders sitting in front of God on their thrones fell on their faces and worshiped God.
Revelation 11:17 Saying, we thank you, God Almighty, who is, who was, and who is to come; because you have used your great power and have become king.
Revelation 11:18 The nations were angry, your anger has come, the time for the dead to be judged, and the time to reward your prophets, your holy people, and all who respect your name, no matter if they are small or great; and the time to destroy those who have ruined the earth.
Revelation 11:19 God's temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant could be seen inside it. There were flashes of lightning, sounds, peals of thunder, an earthquake, and heavy hail.

Revelation 12:1 In heaven, a great sign appeared: a woman dressed in the sun, with the moon under her feet, and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
Revelation 12:2 She was pregnant and cried out in pain as she was about to give birth.
Revelation 12:3 Another amazing thing appeared in the sky; a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns on its heads.
Revelation 12:4 The dragon's tail swept away a third of the stars from the sky and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman about to give birth, ready to eat her child as soon as it was born.
Revelation 12:5 She gave birth to a boy, who would rule all countries with an iron scepter. Her child was taken up to God and His throne.
Revelation 12:6 The woman ran away to the desert, where God had made a place ready for her to be taken care of for one thousand two hundred and sixty days.
Revelation 12:7 There was a war in heaven: Michael and his angels battled the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
Revelation 12:8 They did not win, and they were no longer found in heaven.
Revelation 12:9 The great dragon, that old snake known as the Devil and Satan who tricks everyone, was thrown down to earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.
Revelation 12:10 I heard a loud voice in heaven say, "Now salvation, strength, and God's kingdom, and the power of His Christ are here: the one who accused our brothers, who blamed them before God day and night, has been thrown down."
Revelation 12:11 They defeated him through the Lamb's blood and their testimony; they did not hold onto their lives even in the face of death.
Revelation 12:12 Be happy, heavens, and all who live there. But sadness for the earth and sea people! The devil has come to you very angry, knowing he has little time left.
Revelation 12:13 When the dragon realized he had been thrown down to the earth, he chased the woman who had given birth to the male child.
Revelation 12:14 The woman was given two large eagle wings to fly to the wilderness, to her safe place, where she would be taken care of for a time, times, and half a time, away from the serpent.
Revelation 12:15 The snake shot water from its mouth like a flood at the woman, to sweep her away with the flood.
Revelation 12:16 The earth helped the woman by opening its mouth and swallowing the flood the dragon spat out.
Revelation 12:17 The dragon was angry with the woman and went to fight against the rest of her children, who follow God's commands and have the message of Jesus Christ.

Revelation 13:1 I stood on the sea's shore and saw a beast with seven heads and ten horns come up from the sea. It had ten crowns on its horns and names that insult God on its heads.
Revelation 13:2 The beast I saw was like a leopard, had feet like a bear, and a mouth like a lion; the dragon gave it his power, throne, and great authority.
Revelation 13:3 I saw one of the beast's heads as if it had been fatally wounded, but the deadly wound healed. Everyone in the world was amazed and followed the beast.
Revelation 13:4 They worshiped the dragon because it gave power to the beast: and they worshiped the beast, asking, "Who is like the beast? Who can fight against him?"
Revelation 13:5 He was given a mouth to speak big and disrespectful words; and he was allowed to use his power for 42 months.
Revelation 13:6 He spoke against God with insulting words, to disrespect His name, His dwelling, and those who live in heaven.
Revelation 13:7 He was allowed to fight against God's holy people and to defeat them. He was also given authority over all families, languages, and nations.
Revelation 13:8 Everyone living on Earth will worship him if their names are not in the Lamb's book of life, which was made before the world began.
Revelation 13:9 If anyone can hear, let them listen.
Revelation 13:10 Whoever takes someone captive will be taken captive; whoever kills with the sword must be killed with the sword. This calls for patient endurance and faithfulness from God's people.
Revelation 13:11 I saw another beast rise from the earth; it had two horns like a lamb but spoke like a dragon.
Revelation 13:12 He uses all the power of the first beast in its presence, and makes the earth and its people worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.
Revelation 13:13 He performs great miracles, making fire come down from the sky to earth in front of people.
Revelation 13:14 He tricks the people on earth with the miracles he could do in front of the beast, telling them to make an image of the beast that was hurt by a sword and yet lived.
Revelation 13:15 He could make the beast's image come alive, so it could talk and order the death of anyone not worshiping it.
Revelation 13:16 He makes everyone, whether they are important or not, rich or poor, free or enslaved, have a mark on their right hand or forehead.
Revelation 13:17 No one could buy or sell unless they had the mark, the beast's name, or the number representing his name.
Revelation 13:18 Here is wisdom: Let the person with understanding calculate the beast's number, for it is a man's number; and the number is six hundred sixty-six.

Revelation 14:3 They sang a new song before the throne, the four creatures, and the elders; and only the 144,000 who were saved from the earth could learn the song.
Revelation 14:4 These are the ones who were not impure with women; they are virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were saved from people, the first to be offered to God and the Lamb.
Revelation 14:5 They spoke no lies and are blameless before God's throne.
Revelation 14:6 I saw another angel flying high in the sky, with the eternal good news to tell everyone on earth and to every country, family group, language, and people.
Revelation 14:7 Speak loudly, respect God, and honor Him; because it's time for His judgment: and adore Him who created the sky, the land, the sea, and the water springs.
Revelation 14:8 Another angel followed, saying, "Babylon has fallen, that big city, because she made all countries drink the wine of her anger from her wrong acts."
Revelation 14:9 The third angel followed them and shouted loudly, "If anyone worships the beast and its statue, and gets its mark on their forehead or hand,
Revelation 14:10 That person will drink from the wine of God's anger, which is poured full strength into the cup of his fury; and they will be punished with fire and sulfur in front of the holy angels and the Lamb.
Revelation 14:11 The smoke from their suffering goes up forever and ever, and they have no rest day or night, those who worship the beast and its image, and anyone who accepts the mark of its name.
Revelation 14:12 This shows the patience of God's people: they obey God's commands and stay faithful to Jesus.

Revelation 14:17 Another angel came out of the temple in heaven with a sharp sickle.
Revelation 14:18 Another angel came from the altar, with control over fire, and shouted to the one with the sharp sickle, "Put in your sharp sickle and cut the bunches of grapes from the earth's vines, because they are completely ripe."
Revelation 14:19 The angel swung his sickle on the earth, gathered its grapes, and threw them into the big winepress of God's anger.
Revelation 14:20 People crushed the grapes outside the city, and blood flowed from it as high as horse's bridles, stretching for 200 miles.

Revelation 18:8 Her disasters will happen in one day—death, sadness, and hunger. She will be completely burned with fire because God who judges her is powerful.

Revelation 18:15 The sellers of these goods, who got rich through her, will stand far away because they are afraid of her suffering, crying and mourning.

Revelation 18:17 In one hour, such great wealth has turned to nothing. And every captain, all the ship crews, sailors, and everyone who sails the seas, stood far away.
Revelation 18:18 They cried as they saw the smoke from her burning, asking, "What city is as great as this city?"
Revelation 18:19 They threw dust on their heads, crying and mourning, saying, "How sad, how sad for that great city where everyone with ships at sea got rich from her wealth! In just one hour she has been ruined."
Revelation 18:20 Be happy, heaven, and all you holy messengers and prophets, because God has punished her for what she did to you.

Revelation 18:22 The sounds of harp players, musicians, flute players, and trumpet players will not be heard in you anymore; no worker of any trade will be found in you anymore; and the noise of a millstone will not be heard in you anymore.
Revelation 18:23 Candles will not shine in you anymore; no one will hear the bride or groom's voice in you again. Your traders were powerful on earth; your magic tricks fooled all countries.
Revelation 18:24 In her, people found the blood of prophets, holy people, and everyone killed on earth.

Revelation 21:3 I heard a loud voice from heaven saying, "Look, God's home is now among people, and he will live with them. They will be his people, and God will be with them and be their God."
Revelation 21:4 God will remove all tears from their eyes; no more death, sadness, or crying; no more pain; the old ways are gone.
Revelation 21:5 The one sitting on the throne said, "Look, I am making everything new." Then he told me, "Write these down, because these words are trustworthy and true."
Revelation 21:6 He told me, "It's finished. I am the First and the Last, the start and the end. I will give the thirsty person water from the life spring at no cost."
Revelation 21:7 Whoever wins will receive everything; I will be his God, and he will be my child.
Revelation 21:8 But those who are scared, those who don't believe, those who do bad things, killers, those who sell sex, those who use magic, people who worship idols, and all who lie will go into the lake of fire and sulfur, which means they will die a second time.
Revelation 21:9 One of the seven angels, who had the seven bowls with the last seven plagues, came to me and said, "Come here, I will show you the bride, the Lamb's wife."
Revelation 21:10 He took me in a vision to a tall and big mountain and showed me the great city, the holy Jerusalem, coming down from heaven from God.
Revelation 21:11 It had God's glory, and its light was like a very precious gem, like a clear jasper stone.
Revelation 21:12 It had a large, tall wall with twelve gates, and there were twelve angels at the gates. The names of the twelve tribes of Israel's children were written on the gates.
Revelation 21:13 On the east side, there are three gates; on the north side, three gates; on the south side, three gates; and on the west side, three gates.
Revelation 21:14 The city's wall had twelve base parts, and on them were the names of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
Revelation 21:15 The person speaking with me had a golden rod to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.
Revelation 21:16 The city is shaped like a square, with its length as wide as its width. He measured the city with the rod, twelve thousand stadia. Its length, width, and height are the same.
Revelation 21:17 He measured the wall, and it was 144 cubits tall, using a human measure, which is also an angel's measure.
Revelation 21:18 The city's wall was made of jasper, and the city itself was pure gold, as clear as glass.
Revelation 21:19 The city wall's foundations were decorated with all kinds of valuable stones. The first layer was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald.
Revelation 21:20 The fifth stone is sardonyx; the sixth is carnelian; the seventh is peridot; the eighth is aquamarine; the ninth is topaz; the tenth is green chalcedony; the eleventh is orange zircon; the twelfth is amethyst.
Revelation 21:21 The twelve gates were twelve pearls; each gate was made from a single pearl. The city's main road was pure gold, clear as glass.
Revelation 21:22 I saw no temple there: for God and the Lamb are its temple.
Revelation 21:23 The city did not need the sun or the moon for light because God's glory lit it up, and the Lamb was its light.
Revelation 21:24 The saved nations will walk in its light, and the earth's kings will bring their glory and honor into it.
Revelation 21:25 Its gates will never be closed during the day, because there will be no night there.
Revelation 21:26 They will bring the splendor and respect of the nations into it.
Revelation 21:27 Nothing unclean, no one who does disgusting things or tells lies will enter it, only those whose names are in the Lamb's book of life.

Revelation 22:1 He showed me a clear river of life-giving water, as bright as crystal, flowing from God's throne and the Lamb's.
Revelation 22:2 In the middle of the city's main street and on both sides of the river stood the tree of life. It produced twelve kinds of fruit, giving fresh fruit each month. The tree's leaves were used to heal the nations.
Revelation 22:3 There will be no more curses; God and the Lamb's throne will be there, and his servants will serve him.
Revelation 22:4 They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
Revelation 22:5 There will be no night there; they won't need a candle or sunlight because God will give them light, and they will rule forever and ever.
Revelation 22:6 He told me, "These words are trustworthy and true. God of the holy prophets sent his angel to show his servants what must soon happen."
Revelation 22:7 Look, I am coming soon: happy is the one who follows the teachings of this book's prophecy.
Revelation 22:8 I, John, saw and heard these things. After I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed them to me.
Revelation 22:9 He said to me, "Don't do that. I'm a servant like you and your fellow prophets and all who follow this book's teachings. Worship God."
Revelation 22:10 He said to me, "Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, because the time is near."
Revelation 22:11 Let those who are unfair continue to be unfair, those who are dirty continue to be dirty, those who are right continue to be right, and those who are holy continue to be holy.
Revelation 22:12 Look, I am coming soon, and I bring my reward with me, to give to each one according to what they have done.
Revelation 22:13 I am the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
Revelation 22:14 Happy are those who follow his instructions, so they can have access to the tree of life and enter the city through its gates.
Revelation 22:15 Outside are dogs, magicians, sexually immoral people, killers, idol worshippers, and anyone who loves and makes lies.
Revelation 22:16 I, Jesus, sent my angel to tell you these things in the churches. I am the source and descendant of David, and the bright morning star.
Revelation 22:17 The Spirit and the bride say, "Come." Anyone who hears this should say, "Come." Anyone who is thirsty may come. Anyone who wants to can take the water of life for free.
Revelation 22:18 I tell everyone who hears this book's prophecy: If anyone adds anything to it, God will give them the plagues described in this book.
Revelation 22:19 If anyone takes away from the words of this prophecy, God will remove their share from the book of life, the holy city, and what is written in this book.
Revelation 22:20 The one who tells us these things says, "Yes, I will come soon." Amen. Come, Jesus.
Revelation 22:21 May the kindness of our Lord Jesus Christ be with everyone. Amen.
